record.evidence.guardian.requirements.text: Use the supplied Sleepyhead identity direction only as provisional guidance: the excerpts’ approval and version are unknown. Preserve the recorded white-colour discrepancy; do not treat #231F20 as white or resolve the conflict without corrected source artwork.

Use authentic Sleepyhead logo artwork and appropriate supplied variants; preserve its proportions and legibility. Do not redraw, rotate, recolour, add effects, or use it on poor-contrast or busy backgrounds. Production logo files were not supplied.
For scenes, reserve copy and logo space on a real wall or backdrop; do not add artificial patches, haze, fades, or blur masks to rescue contrast.

Lock the exact Sleepyhead SKU and variant using official product evidence. Keep its appearance, colour, fabric, proportions, construction, branding, and documented features truthful; inspiration imagery is not product proof.
Keep copy useful and clear; do not make unsupported product promises.

record.evidence.guardian.preferences.text: The supplied excerpts describe a human-centred, young, vibrant, quirky and playful personality with friendly wit. Treat this as supplied direction, not evidence of customer response.

Explore whole-room inspiration: believable architecture, room scale and circulation, coherent colour relationships, tactile materials, daylight, useful furniture groupings and lived-in activity. The selected references are inspiration, not mandatory styling or permission to copy third-party work.

Playfulness need not mean maximal colour or props: the supplied spatial research includes both bright expressive rooms and quieter, colour-aware alternatives. Orange may identify the brand without recolouring the room or product.
The official-site screenshot shows an orange-accented navigation and product categories, alongside a vivid sale promotion. These are current site observations, not permanent campaign or layout rules.
The supplied excerpts suggest humorous, informal, creative and personable language; use conversational wit while keeping the message approachable and clear.
